text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp has arrived. Air Shakur is

determined to get in tip-top form for the
Kikuka
Sho—and for the new future it
will bring.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is an essential period. The
growth I
can achieve here will have a
direct impact on my
future.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've reorganized our training schedule.
I'll make
changes as necessary, but this
will be the main
plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I really am terrifically excited. I've gone
over all
the relevant training so much
that I know it by
heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no way Air Shakur can use her
computer
the whole time in this blazing
heat.
choice_data_list_en: (I really want to be of help this time!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pulled an all-nighter and memorized as
much
important data as possible so that
I'll be ready
when she has to put the
computer away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It took me until the day of the Derby
itself to do
something truly helpful, so I
want to use this
summer camp to
improve my own skills as a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's already all decided. I don't need you
for
anything.
choice_data_list: どんなことでも言ってくれ
どんなことでも言ってね

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait... I guess you can carry my
water bottle.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't go burstin' a blood vessel from all
the
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seriously. There's no point in getting
excited. At
all.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It's kinda difficult to tell which one of
them is supposed
to be the trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so begins our summer camp of
blazing
growth.
